info.album: True Colors: The Best Of Cyndi Lauper

podcast.body: As one of four top-ten singles for Cyndi Lauper in 1984, this song helped define her successful run during that influential year for pop music. "Girls just want to have fun, time after time, she-bop, and all through the night. All of which were released or peaked in 1984."

podcast.body: This track achieved a number five position on the charts, completing the quartet of top five hits from Cyndi Lauper's debut album, "She's So Unusual." Its success solidified her status as the first woman to achieve such a feat from a single LP. "and the number five hit all through the night."
